deficiencies.description: In the source text, 'signaling' is a noun coordinate with 'basis' ('a signaling and basis'), stating two functions provided by the basement membrane. The rewrite turns 'signalling' into an adjective modifying 'basis' ('a signalling basis'), altering its syntactic role and narrowing the meaning.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: provides a signaling and basis for their adherence to this layer.
